pr_title: executor: Trace the memory usage of `AggFunc` in `HashAggExec`
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #14705 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: Trace the memory usage of `AggFunc` in `HashAggExec`.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

In order to track memory more accurately, we modify functions `AllocPartialResult`, `UpdatePartialResult` and `MergePartialResult`, add a return value `memDelta int64` to identify the memory used.

```
type AggFunc interface {
	AllocPartialResult() (PartialResult, int64)
	UpdatePartialResult(sctx sessionctx.Context, rowsInGroup []chunk.Row, pr PartialResult) (int64, error)
	MergePartialResult(sctx sessionctx.Context, src, dst PartialResult) (int64, error)
}
```

We need to modify all aggregate functions, we temporarily set the return value to `int64(0)` in this PR, so that we can modify them one by one.

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

### Release note

- trace the memory usage of `AggFunc` in `HashAggExec`

issue_context.title: make the memory tracing in `HashAggExec` more accurate
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->
A `memTracker` is used to trace memory consumed by `Chunks` in `HashAggExec`, but in some cases(https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/14024), the `aggPartialResultMapper` used to store intermediate results consumes a lot of memory but we don't trace it now.

Please help us to make the memory tracing in `HashAggExec` more accurate by tracing all memory consumed by the `aggPartialResultMapper`.

If you are interested in this issue, welcome to join [our SIG-EXEC channel](https://tidbcommunity.slack.com/archives/CMRD79DRR) to discuss it with us.
Thanks for your contribution:D
